# Neon Aether

> Neon Aether is an independent game studio and the developer of the retro sci-fi platformer Neon Aether.

The game's planned launch is February 10, 2027. Planned platforms are PC / Steam, iOS, and Android. Features include pixel art, alien-world exploration, dynamic combat, and puzzles. The official website currently accepts launch waitlist signups.

## Official website

- [Neon Aether](https://neonaether.netlify.app/): Studio and game overview.
- [Game features](https://neonaether.netlify.app/#features): Gameplay and pixel-art details.
- [Pricing](https://neonaether.netlify.app/#pricing): Advertised full-game price.
- [Launch waitlist](https://neonaether.netlify.app/#waitlist): Email signup for launch news.
